summary: Feed s106_single to IDS is degraded: VLAN 20 is completely missing (50% of packets untagged) while IDS requires VLANs 10 and 20. All other visibility checks (duplicates, one-way, drops, overload, encryption) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker is stripping 802.1Q tags or VLAN 20 is pruned/filtered on the ingress trunk/broker map. 50% untagged matches the expected share of VLAN 20, indicating tags are removed before delivery to the IDS tool port or a VLAN filter is dropping VLAN 20.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS requires both VLAN 10 and 20 with full payload and bidirectional visibility. Missing VLAN 20 blinds the IDS to ~50% of traffic, creating a complete detection gap for that segment and breaking correlation across VLANs.

recommended_fix.why: Preserve 802.1Q tags end-to-end and ensure VLAN 20 is explicitly forwarded to the IDS tool port so the IDS receives complete, correctly segmented traffic for both required VLANs.
